page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-lc1m4.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.t5 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 virtual CPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. This configuration provides 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that this instance operates in a lower performance tier. The CPU allocation is burstable, meaning it is designed for workloads with variable CPU utilization. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance scored 1093.49, while multi-core performance scored 2133.08. Memory bandwidth tests show 124.93 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 16.1 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Geekbench results reflect similar constraints, with a single-core score of 880.0 and a multi-core score of 1470.0.

Given its burstable CPU model and modest hardware profile, this server type represents a budget-friendly option for workloads that do not require sustained high CPU performance. It is appropriate for low-traffic static web serving, which benchmarked at 2.22 GB/sec, or basic database operations, with Redis SET operations reaching 1.47 million operations per second. Appropriate use cases include development and testing environments, lightweight microservices, and background tasks with intermittent resource demands.
